workflow: A worker exits while its per-thread local state is being torn down.
Destroying a value in that state runs user finalization code that accesses the same thread-local container and recreates auxiliary per-thread state.
Teardown continues using its original cleanup sequence and does not reclaim the state recreated during finalization.
The recreated bookkeeping objects remain allocated after the worker finishes, so leak detection reports a memory leak instead of clean shutdown.
summary: Reentrant finalization recreates state during teardown and leaks it
decision_reason: No existing cluster has the same underlying workflow: user finalization re-enters a thread-local container during per-thread teardown, recreates cleanup state, and leaves that newly created state unreclaimed.
